title: Noun くらい～ (Noun kurai～)
shortExplanation: Express the extent or degree of something; 'about', 'approximately', 'at least'.
longExplanation: The くらい grammar point is used with a noun to express the extent or degree of something, meaning 'about', 'approximately', or 'at least' in English. It helps to provide a rough estimate or minimum standard to the noun it is attached to.

examples.jp: この本は三百ページくらいあります。
examples.romaji: Kono hon wa sanbyaku peeji kurai arimasu.

examples.jp: 彼の家まで歩いて20分くらいかかります。
examples.romaji: Kare no ie made aruite nijuppun kurai kakarimasu.
examples.en: It takes about 20 minutes to walk to his house.

examples.jp: 明日は暑くて、30度くらいになるでしょう。
examples.romaji: Ashita wa atsukute, sanjuu-do kurai ni naru deshou.
examples.en: Tomorrow will be hot, about 30 degrees.

examples.jp: この料理を作るのに、材料は500円くらい必要です。
examples.romaji: Kono ryouri o tsukuru no ni, zairyou wa gohyaku-en kurai hitsuyou desu.
examples.en: You need about 500 yen worth of ingredients to make this dish.

usageNote: Neutral, standard way to express an approximate quantity or degree. (Near-duplicate of n3-012 - same word, taught at both N3 and N5.)
